summary: Comprehensive architectural implementation plan to refactor the Pi-Digit digital twin platform based on user requirements: removing live emulator launch buttons from the main landing page, adding deep internal architecture documentation to the wiki, expanding the curriculum with Tic-Tac-Toe, pixel mover, separate LCD vs RGB programs, advanced C examples, and a C character device driver; creating a dedicated pop-out Camera window with real-time edge detection and grayscale gradient filtering; revamping the Code Studio to feature realistic light/dark themes, file persistence to Pi storage, and long-running execution; removing simulated sensor toggles in favor of an explicit Disconnected state; uncurving the 8x8 LED matrix canvas corners; fixing the unlink bridge state; simplifying diagnostic views into dense engineer-grade status tables; adding an I2C hardware disclaimer note to the LCD; adding structured file logging in logs/; and writing automated component verification test scripts.
